d:
30 navanbar se shuru hone vala bihar vidhanasbha ka shitkalin satr 4 disanbar tak chalega. kul panch dinon ki karyavahi men is bar sabse jyada utsukta prashant kishor ko lekar hai. chunavi ranniti banane se lekar bihar men jan abhiyan chalane tak ka saphar tay karne vale prashant kishor ab pahli bar vidhanasbha ke bhitar vidhayak ke taur par apni bhumika nibhaenge.
